header.question: Evaluate the breaking alert claiming that Orvan Grain Port infrastructure and grain terminal silos were physically destroyed in military strikes. Conduct event verification to rule whether this disruption is verified or rejected as a decoy, citing verified port authority and logistics records.
header.ruling_mode: run 1: MODEL_ON_OPEN_CLAIMS; run 2: MODEL_ON_OPEN_CLAIMS; narrative MODEL

executive_summary.text: Premise check: the claim of destroyed is rejected as unsupported by the evidence.
